panels.title: Best tests passing so far

annotations.label: answer key = 261
annotations.note: the human's own merged PR, on this grader

panels.caveat: Monotone by construction -- the harness restores the best tree after a regression. A flat line means no attempt beat the first, not that nothing happened.

panels.title: Tests passing, per attempt
panels.caveat: 0 means two opposite things -- migration not started, or the agent broke the package so the suite cannot import. Read this panel WITH v1_remaining, never alone.

panels.title: Pydantic v1 surfaces left in the package

annotations.label: floor = 2 (a COMPLETED migration)
annotations.note: not zero: the merged PR still counts this many, so the axis must not imply 0 is the target

panels.caveat: A source count, not an oracle: reaching the floor does not mean the migration is correct, only that the v1 spellings are gone. The suite remains the only thing that decides.

panels.title: Files in the package that still compile
panels.caveat: Read WITH work_remaining. Few surfaces left and files not parsing is 'did the work and broke it'; many surfaces and everything parsing is 'kept it valid by not doing it'. Both score 0 on the suite.

panels.title: Cumulative attempt tokens
panels.caveat: ATTEMPT tokens only. Distillation is off the clock and counted separately -- see the distillation panel. Warm's prompt carries the skill, so a bigger skill costs warm tokens on every turn and that is a real cost, not noise.

panels.title: Score against spend, per attempt
panels.caveat: Deliberately not a tokens-per-test ratio: most attempts score 0 and the ratio is undefined for them, so a mean would be computed over the minority that happened to pass.

panels.title: Graph writes and agent retrievals
panels.caveat: Zero retrievals is a finding, not a gap in the chart: it means the agent had memory and chose not to use it. Writes happening while retrievals stay at 0 is the exact shape that went unnoticed for ~40 runs.

panels.title: Skill version, and what each attempt ran on
panels.caveat: Distillation happens AFTER an attempt, so attempt N's result belongs to the version that existed before it. A rejected proposal leaves the version unchanged and is marked -- rejections are the interesting points.

panels.title: How attempts ended
panels.caveat: A rollback is not a failure -- it is the harness keeping the best tree after a regression. A silent rollback and an agent that recovered by itself look identical without this.

panels.title: When each arm was working
panels.caveat: Distillation bars are OFF the attempt clock -- the deadline is extended by their duration, so warm does not lose thinking time to bookkeeping. If the arms are not overlapping, they were not running concurrently and the wall-clock comparison is worthless.

cost.note: GPU spend covers this RUN only; provisioning and the model download happen before the first event.
